parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A rectangular wooden drawer that fits into the table structure, typically used for storing small items.
parts.Functional_description: It provides storage space and can be pulled out or pushed in using a handle or grip area.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally in and out along rails or grooves.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A hinged wooden door attached to the cabinet section of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the storage compartment, allowing access when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden panel located at the rear of the table structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural stability and prevents items from falling out the back.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Left)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden panel forming the left side support of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the tabletop and connects to other structural panels.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Right)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden panel forming the right side support of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the tabletop and connects to the drawer and cabinet structure.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Inner Divider)
parts.Basic_description: An internal vertical wooden divider separating the drawer and cabinet compartments.
parts.Functional_description: It provides internal structural support and separates storage sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Bottom Panel
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden panel forming the base of the cabinet section.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and connects to the side and back panels.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: A large flat wooden surface forming the top of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main working surface for writing, placing objects, or using a computer.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.
